findings.text: follow-on: the new guard skips a live local worker whose project differs from the pick's project, so expected_wait_s no longer reflects the whole live local load; when another project's local workers are the only ones live the figure reads null (or low) while the lane is genuinely busy. Deliberate and pinned by test_expected_wait_never_reads_a_foreign_project_ledger, but it narrows a figure the picker prompt describes as the median wall time for the local runs now live, and the cost argument (one foreign ledger read) is a latency trade rather than a correctness one.

follow-on: the fallback re-calls routing._context_fit_verdict when the competence verdict carried no context; that branch is safe because _context_fit_verdict returns None only when neither usable_input_window nor effective_input_window is declared (a settings lookup, no repository walk), so no second git subprocess runs on the expensive path. Recorded for completeness, not a defect.

follow-on: the reviewed run's manifest baseline_suite/after_suite carry a non-schema shape (arm/revision/tree/passed/failed/duration_s/exit/note) rather than the required keys (revision, command, exit_status, log_path, completed, failure_count, failure_ids); gate-base.log's header command line is also truncated (test_picker_inputs_never_block_document) though run_base.sh's real pytest command ran in full. Record-shape only; the derived delta is unaffected (both logs show 0 failed).

item_verdicts.call_sites: read the two production call sites the node touches: snapshot._fit now consumes the context under competence['context'] (snapshot.py:172) and falls back only when it is absent (snapshot.py:174); lane_context._expected_wait gains the foreign-project guard (lane_context.py:262).
item_verdicts.diff: read a3e0bc20 against its parent c6acda8e0: 9e45069bb changes snapshot.py (context read from the competence verdict with a fallback) and lane_context.py (skip owner != project when records is held), adds tests/test_picker_pick_within_bound.py; a3e0bc20 adds the evidence fragment, the per-phase figure and its plot script.
item_verdicts.done_when: the node's done-when is the pick latency inside the 5 s dispatch bound; the manifest records base 122 passed and head 126 passed with zero added failures, and an independent HEAD re-run of tests/test_picker_pick_within_bound.py passes 4.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal under plan §6 (f-otmp-pick-timeouts) is to bring the dispatch-path pick inside its 5 s bound; the diff removes a second instruction-chain context measurement per candidate and a foreign-project ledger read from the wait estimate.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, base and head gate logs named under the run directory, negative-control.log named with EXIT=1 and the fit test as the single failing id.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; the diff touches only reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py, reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py, tests/test_picker_pick_within_bound.py and the fragment/figure under docs, all inside them.

justifications.durability: each cut is pinned by a test that fails loudly if reverted: test_fit_reuses_the_competence_context_measurement monkeypatches the second measurement to raise, and test_expected_wait_never_reads_a_foreign_project_ledger makes run_time_profile fail if a foreign ledger is read; the negative control reinstates the fit cut and records EXIT=1 with exactly that test failing. The second cut's falsification is self-contained but is not itself run as a recorded red.
justifications.evidence: base 122 passed / head 126 passed derive from gate-base.log and gate-head.log (both EXIT=0, zero failures); negative-control.log shows 1 failed / 3 passed EXIT=1; the per-phase profile is the median of three runs with the ledger held; an independent HEAD re-run of the new file passes 4. Blemishes: gate-base.log's header command line is truncated and it carries a duplicated appended run, and the manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite use a non-schema shape.
justifications.fit: the added lines follow the surrounding picker idiom and comment voice; comments state the mechanism (a second instruction-chain read, a foreign ledger on the critical path) with no plan, sprint or ticket identifiers and no author attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the pick inside its bound is met and measured (median total about 3.34 s to about 1.37 s, no ledger-scaling phase left inside pick()), and the fit cut is behaviour-preserving because _competence_verdict calls _context_fit_verdict on every return path and its context value is the same measurement; the wait-estimate cut, however, narrows expected_wait_s to the pick's own project, so the figure no longer reports the whole live local load.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path (reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py, reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py, tests/test_picker_pick_within_bound.py, docs/evidence/fragments/.../picker-pick-within-bound.html and the figure directory) is inside the declared write paths, and the node mutated no plan or sprint state.
